newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico extradites ETA suspect to Spain - report.
newsitem.headline: Mexico extradites ETA suspect to Spain - report.

text.p: Mexico on Friday extradited a suspected member of the Basque separatist group ETA to Spain, from which he fled in 1983 to escape a six-year prison sentence, the Mexican news agency Notimex reported.
Quoting sources in the Mexican embassy in Madrid, Notimex said Pedro Maria Garmendia Alberde was en route to Madrid where he would be handed over to Spanish police.
Officials at Mexico's Interior Ministry were not immediately available to comment on the report.
Notimex said Garmendia Alberde fled from Spain in 1983 after being sentenced to six years in jail for arms possession and ETA-related activities.

Reports in Mexican newspapers on Friday said another ETA suspect, Oscar Cadenas Lorente, could also be deported from Mexico to Spain. He is in detention in Mexico, and his lawyers were fighting for his right to stay here, the daily La Jornada said.
